description: This file defines the FontManager class, which manages font files for the SugarCRM SuiteCRM project. It handles loading font details, listing available fonts, adding new fonts, deleting fonts, and caching font lists.

classes.name: FontManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing font files in the SuiteCRM system, including loading, listing, adding, deleting, and caching font data.

methods.name: setFontPath
methods.description: Sets the font path based on the existence of font files in custom or default directories.

methods.name: getEmbedded
methods.description: Determines whether the current font is embedded based on font type.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of the font (regular, bold, italic, etc.) based on filename pattern.

methods.name: getFontSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the font files in kilobytes.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Populates font details into the fontList array based on font file content.

methods.name: loadFontFile
methods.description: Loads and validates a font file, extracting font metadata.

methods.name: parseFolder
methods.description: Scans font directories and populates fontList with font files found.

methods.name: listFontFiles
methods.description: Lists available font files, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getSelectFontList
methods.description: Returns an array suitable for select options, listing available fonts.

methods.name: getFilenameShort
methods.description: Returns the filename without the .php extension.

methods.name: deleteFont
methods.description: Deletes a font file and related cache, only if user is admin.

methods.name: addFont
methods.description: Adds a new font to the system by generating and saving font files, only if user is admin.

methods.name: clearCachedFile
methods.description: Removes the cached font list file.

methods.name: fontFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a font file exists by attempting to load it.
